description: Bridge Inlet is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This data has been collected as part of a larger project by the City of Austin's Watershed Protection and Development Review Department to inventory its drainage infrastructure and create a GIS to store this information. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure. Its tags are wpd, agoltosocrata, watershed, stormwater, storm sewer. The table has 63 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
